item.title: Annotello 1.3.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.3.0

  • Share Live: edit a Steps guide with your team at the same time. Click Share Live in the Steps window and send the link.
  • Captions, step order, markers and screenshots sync instantly, and everyone's presence shows in the window.
  • End-to-end encrypted: the key is part of the link and never reaches the server. Sensitive text is blurred before sharing.
  • Open a guide someone shared from the link, or with Open Shared Guide… in the menu bar menu.
